elements.title: Import Source Diversity and External Debt Burdens, by Food Group, Income Group, and Population, 2025 (continued)

axes.x: External debt stocks as share of exports (%, log scale)

data.label: Vertical dashed line
data.series: External debt stocks as share of exports

elements.description: Two panels show import-source diversity against external debt burdens in 2025 for fruits and vegetables. Points represent economies, with colors denoting income groups and sizes denoting population. Both fitted lines slope downward, indicating lower source diversity at higher debt burdens; individual economies are not labeled.
elements.notes:
Sources: Original calculations based on data from the World Bank Group’s International Debt Statistics and World Development Indicators databases, and the World Integrated Trade Solution database.
Note: The Shannon Diversity Index measures the diversity of an economy’s food import sources; higher values indicate greater diversification, whereas lower values indicate greater concentration. Each panel includes 83 economies. The vertical dashed line marks external debt stocks of 150 percent of exports. Fitted lines are population-weighted ordinary least squares regressions with 95 percent confidence intervals. Additional regressions discussed in the text control for log gross national income per capita.
